note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: Why external-teacher KD fails for DLMs and how SelFusion's self-distillation works

nodes.name: DLMs trail LLMs in quality
nodes.description: Diffusion language models offer faster parallel decoding than autoregressive LLMs but have lower generation quality, e.g. 10-32% worse perplexity than AR baselines.

nodes.name: LLM-to-DLM logit mismatch
nodes.description: LLM teachers give peaked distributions (near 100% top-1 probability) while DLMs give flatter ones (about 60% at 50% masking), and top-1 token overlap is only about 60%, so logit-level KD from an LLM is ineffective.

nodes.name: DLM teachers are too weak
nodes.description: DLM teachers' generation quality is far below AR models, so logit-level KD gives marginal gains at higher training cost and sequence-level KD is of limited effectiveness.

nodes.name: Existing KD fails to help DLMs
nodes.description: Conventional logit- and sequence-level KD, from LLM or DLM teachers, give only marginal gains or degrade over the DLM SFT baseline (e.g. Dolly 15.11 with LLM logit KD vs 18.77 SFT at 8 steps).

nodes.name: Easy and hard modes
nodes.description: SelFusion runs two forward passes in one model: a hard mode with the original random masking and an easy mode with a lower masking ratio that exposes more context.

nodes.name: Easy mode is a better teacher on average
nodes.description: The easy mode assigns higher probability to ground-truth tokens than the hard mode, with the gap growing from about 6% to about 10% over training, and keeps a distribution close to the student's.

nodes.name: Easy mode is not always right
nodes.description: Despite more context the easy mode is not always more accurate and can be overconfident on incorrect tokens; hard-to-easy distillation beats easy-to-hard on several benchmarks.

nodes.name: Bidirectional KD
nodes.description: Per token, the distillation direction follows correctness and confidence: if both correct the higher-probability mode teaches, if both wrong the one with higher ground-truth probability teaches, otherwise the correct mode teaches.

nodes.name: RMSNorm logit calibration
nodes.description: RMSNorm calibration cuts overconfidence mostly on wrong predictions (about 40% to 10% top-1 probability when both modes are wrong, versus 90% to 60% when both are right).

nodes.name: Ablations confirm components
nodes.description: Removing either unidirectional direction or RMSNorm consistently degrades performance, and neither unidirectional variant matches bidirectional KD.

nodes.name: SelFusion outperforms KD baselines
nodes.description: SelFusion beats the strongest baseline (LLM-to-DLM sequence-level KD) by 2-4 points (about 16% relative) and DLM SFT by 1.5-3 points across five benchmarks.

nodes.name: Student surpasses LLM teacher
nodes.description: SelFusion exceeds the LLM teacher on multiple benchmarks, e.g. 12.87 vs 11.04 on Self-inst, 17.08 vs 14.95 on Vicuna, 23.21->27.07 on Sinst.

nodes.name: Cheaper without teacher
nodes.description: SelFusion needs about 2x per-iteration compute of SFT but removes teacher training, cutting total training cost roughly 2x versus KD with a separately trained teacher, with only 1,280 extra parameters.

isolated_nodes.name: Larger diffusion steps
isolated_nodes.description: SelFusion generally outperforms baseline distillation at 32 diffusion steps, achieving the best average performance.

isolated_nodes.name: DLMs are faster at inference
isolated_nodes.description: Even with 32 diffusion steps DLMs achieve about 1.5x speedup over LLMs in practice, due to parallel token generation.

isolated_nodes.name: Evaluation scope limited
isolated_nodes.description: Validation is limited by few available DLM backbones and to English instruction tuning.

structural_reasoning: Failure analysis of external-teacher KD motivates the two-mode self-distillation; mode asymmetry and its limits lead to bidirectional KD with calibration, whose ablations and main results follow.
